moves.text: Rahu moves from Kumbha into Makara.
moves.until_text: Rahu stays in Makara until 24 June 2028, when it moves into Dhanu.

moves.text: Ketu moves from Simha into Kataka.
moves.until_text: Ketu stays in Kataka until 24 June 2028, when it moves into Mithuna.

moves.text: Rahu leaves your 11th house and enters your 10th house.
moves.from_theme: The 11th house is about gains and friends.
moves.to_theme: The 10th house is about career and standing.

moves.text: Ketu leaves your 5th house and enters your 4th house.
moves.from_theme: The 5th house is about learning, children and creativity.
moves.to_theme: The 4th house is about home and peace of mind.
